analysis:
The Smart Cities Mission was launched on 25 June 2015 with a target of 100 cities, selected across rounds between 2016 and 2018, supported by a Rs 48,000 crore central outlay.

A Standing Committee report (2023-24) said that by 31 January 2023, 5,343 of 7,821 projects were complete, that 68 cities had not met physical targets and that 32 cities exceeding their targets inflated the headline figure. The mission period was extended to June 2024 and then to 31 March 2025; by July 2024 the ministry reported about 90% of projects complete.

A secondary source cites a July 2025 committee report with 7,636 of 8,063 projects complete (about 95%); this was not verified against the report.
notes: Not a single verbatim promise: the claim is the mission's stated aim of 100 smart cities. Modi's launch speech transcript not found (Aaj Tak live blog only). Original mission period/deadline not verified (sources point to June 2024 before the March 2025 extension; a June 2023 date mentioned in the 2023 article is unconfirmed). The 5 Aug 2024 Rajya Sabha PDF and 2025 committee numbers were only seen via search summaries. Verdict 'missed-deadline' is based on repeated extensions; a reviewer may prefer 'in-progress'/'misleading' depending on reading.
